items.verseEn: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.
Indeed, to Us is their return.
Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

items.verse: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
items.verseEn: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.

categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتُ الْكَافِرِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الزُّخْرُفِ
categories.nameEn: Terms for the disbelievers in Surah Az-Zukhruf

items.verse: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
items.verseEn: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

items.verse: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
items.verseEn: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

items.verse: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
items.verseEn: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

items.verse: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
items.verseEn: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

categories.name: كَلِمَاتٌ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْمُطَفِّفِينَ
categories.nameEn: Key Terms in Surah Al-Mutaffifin on Fraud and Resurrection

items.verse: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
items.verseEn: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
Do they not think that they will be resurrected
The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

categories.name: أَحْوَالٌ مَنْصُوبَةٌ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
categories.nameEn: Quranic Circumstantial Adverbs (Hāl) in the Accusative

items.verse: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
items.verseEn: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."

items.verse: وَلِكُلٍّۢ وِجْهَةٌ هُوَ مُوَلِّيهَا ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ أَيْنَ مَا تَكُونُوا۟ يَأْتِ بِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
items.verseEn: For each [religious following] is a [prayer] direction toward which it faces. So race to [all that is] good. Wherever you may be, Allāh will bring you forth [for judgement] all together. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

items.verse: فَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ فَرِجَالًا أَوْ رُكْبَانًۭا ۖ فَإِذَآ أَمِنتُمْ فَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَمَا عَلَّمَكُم مَّا لَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: And if you fear [an enemy, then pray] on foot or riding. But when you are secure, then remember Allāh [in prayer], as He has taught you that which you did not [previously] know.

items.verse: أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًۭا وَكَرْهًۭا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
items.verseEn: So is it other than the religion of Allāh they desire, while to Him have submitted [all] those within the heavens and earth, willingly or by compulsion, and to Him they will be returned?

harf.hint: An overwhelming, violent act of seizing — used in Surah Ad-Dukhan to describe a great day of divine vengeance
harf.arabicVerse: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
harf.verse: 44:16 - The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

deduction.title: The Unheeded Call in the Land of Arrogance
deduction.intro: You stand in the ruins of a once-great civilization, where power and pride knew no bounds. A messenger walked among them, calling to the truth, but their hearts were hardened. The warning went unheeded, and the sky itself became an instrument of wrath. Who was this messenger, and what became of those who rejected the call?
clues: I was sent to a people who were unmatched in strength and who built on every high place a monument.
My people considered themselves invincible and said, 'Who is mightier than us in strength?'
I called them to worship Allah alone, but they accused me of foolishness and lying.
They challenged me to bring the punishment I promised if I was truthful.
Allah sent upon them a barren wind that spared nothing it came upon.
I and those who believed with me were saved by Allah's mercy, while the disbelievers were utterly destroyed.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: A devastating wind destroyed the disbelievers
A great flood engulfed the disbelievers
A shower of stones rained down
A loud shriek seized the disbelievers
trial.answer: A devastating wind destroyed the disbelievers

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Hud and the believers were saved, and the disbelievers were destroyed
Hud was raised to a high station
Hud was killed by his people
Hud's people repented and were spared
Hud left his people before any punishment
outcome.answer: Hud and the believers were saved, and the disbelievers were destroyed

deduction.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعْنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ۖ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
deduction.verse: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers. (7:72)

scramble.hint: Allah's reassuring words to two prophets facing a powerful tyrant — a reminder of His constant presence, hearing, and sight over all.
scramble.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
scramble.verseEn: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.

root.meaning: This root centers on the idea of lifting something upward, whether in a physical sense or in rank and honor. Its various forms spread out to express the action of raising, describe something lifted high, and name the one who elevates others.
